frozen_policy.chain_record_selection_rule: For the selected coordinate file, parse every Foldseek structureto3didescriptor record, choose the longest amino-acid/3Di record, and record all alternatives. Ties are resolved deterministically by Foldseek record id then record index.
frozen_policy.pooling_contract: whole_sequence/whole_structure only for this primary benchmark; active-site pooling remains future ablation.
frozen_policy.selected_structure_rule: Use the selected_structure_proxy_id from the frozen current702 split artifact. Only selected PDB/mmCIF provenance is eligible for primary SaProt tokenization in this artifact.
frozen_policy.token_pair_rule: Pair each Foldseek-emitted amino acid with the aligned Foldseek 3Di token converted to lowercase, producing SaProt tokens like Aa/Ev. No label, EC, name, prose, or expert-note fields enter tokenization.
frozen_policy.unsupported_token_rule: Rows with noncanonical amino-acid symbols, unsupported 3Di symbols, AA/3Di length mismatch, missing selected coordinates, or selected records longer than the model maximum are blocked and must be counted as coordinate/tokenization abstentions in benchmark metrics.

model_policy.rationale: Use the public 35M SaProt HF/Transformers checkpoint for bounded CPU feasibility; 650M is recorded as full-size reference but not downloaded because repository metadata reports ~5.21 GB across duplicate weight formats.
